description: This file defines an interface 'IBaseCodecProvider' in the namespace 'Orleans.Serialization.Serializers', which provides a method for obtaining base codecs for specified types in the Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: IBaseCodecProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides access to implementations of 'IBaseCodec{T}'.

methods.name: GetBaseCodec
methods.description: Returns a base codec for the specified type 'TField'.
